'''Sweet berry jam''' is the preservation of [[sweet berries]]. It heals {{Hp|4}} and grants {{EffectLink|Health Boost}} for 3 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/sweet_berry_jam.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Sweet berry mash]], sugar and a glass bottle. Obtaining sweet berry mash unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating sweet berry jam takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|4}} and gives Health Boost I (+2 hearts of maximum health) for 3:00. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.5-alpha|Sweet berry jam is no longer a honey bottle.}}
{{History line|1.0|Removed from bastion chests.}}
